name: Rania Haddad
headline: 28, part-time university tutor and freelance translator, Amman
description: Rania teaches academic writing at a private university in Amman on a per-course contract and supplements her income with freelance Arabic-to-English translations. Since her divorce she has shared an apartment with her younger brother and his wife, and she often holds make-up classes in the family's kitchen for students who cannot afford internet. She brings leftover bread and jam to office hours and never turns away a student who just needs to talk.
